subject.title: Control UI Dashboard v2 freezes on Chrome 146 (works fine in Firefox)

question: Should maintainers first require live current-main Chromium proof and a narrow render-trigger fix, or sponsor a broader safe UI fallback for affected Control UI users?
rationale: The issue is credible, but current main changed the suspected shell path and choosing a fallback mode would add user-visible Control UI behavior without proof of the current trigger.

options.title: Reproduce then fix the trigger
options.body: Use live Chromium diagnostics on current main to identify the shell/layout trigger and land the narrowest fix.

options.title: Design a safe UI fallback
options.body: Add an explicit simplified shell or browser-safe fallback for affected Chromium builds, accepting the broader product surface.

options.title: Close after no current repro
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide a current-main Chromium reproduction cannot be obtained and the report is no longer actionable.

recommendation.title: Reproduce then fix the trigger
recommendation.body: Use live Chromium diagnostics on current main to identify the shell/layout trigger and land the narrowest fix.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has the strongest Dashboard v2 and responsive-refresh history for deciding whether this should be a narrow UI fix or a fallback surface.
